calls.head: NY Rangers’s power play has a target
calls.body: NY Rangers ranks 10th of 32 on the power play (7.7 expected goals per 60); NY Islanders ranks 30th on the penalty kill.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: NY Rangers’s power play created 25.7 expected goals per 60 in 3:52 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 7.7, and scored 1 goal.

surprises.head: NY Rangers tried a different line
surprises.body: J. Miller, P. Dorofeyev, T. Kartye played 9:16 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of NY Rangers’s usual lines.
